title: Rill profile
description: A declarative profile: dialect visuals + op semantics (docs/PROFILE_SPEC.md) and, optionally, an input-format import mapping (docs/IMPORT_SPEC.md). This schema is the canonical definition of profile legality; the in-app validator adds friendlier did-you-mean messages.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editor tooling; ignored by the app.

name.description: Profile identifier, shown in the profile debug UI.

description.description: Free-form description of what this profile covers.

dialects.description: Dialect name → accent color, either a hex string or { color }.

classify.description: First-match-wins rules assigning ops a rendering class. Unmatched ops default to "compute".

as.description: compute: full node. aux: small dashed node, hideable. structural: never drawn, edges chased through. container: currently like compute.

regions.description: How region-opening ops are parsed (MLIR front-end only).

policy.description: opaque: consume the body inline as one node. descend: body ops become children.

captureBody.description: Keep body lines on the node (genericBody) for summarize `when` conditions.

summarize.description: First-match-wins purpose badges ({label, icon, color}) replacing the op name on nodes.

label.description: Short purpose label shown on the node.

import.description: Input-format import mapping: parses non-MLIR sources (protobuf text format) into the op graph. See docs/IMPORT_SPEC.md.

detect.description: When this importer claims an opened file. Without it the mapping only applies via explicit routing.

extensions.description: File extensions (no dot) this importer claims, e.g. ["prototxt", "pbtxt"].

contentRegex.description: Multiline-tested regex used to sniff files whose extension didn't match (e.g. .txt).

dialect.description: Dialect assigned to every imported op; drives colors and matchers.

list.description: Candidate repeated-field names holding the node list; the first with entries wins (e.g. ["layer", "layers"]).

name.description: Dotted field path to the node's display name.

type.description: Dotted field path to the node's type (string or bare enum).

inputs.description: Dotted field path to consumed value names (Caffe: "bottom").

outputs.description: Dotted field path to produced value names (Caffe: "top").

drop.description: Drop a node when the value at path equals the given value (string-compared). E.g. TEST-phase layers.

opName.description: How op names are built from node types. Default prefix is dialect + ".".

prefix.description: Prepended to the mapped type, e.g. "caffe.".

map.description: Raw type → canonical name (legacy enums like CONVOLUTION → Convolution). Unmapped types pass through.

attrs.description: Explicit attr extractions; win over auto-collected params on collision.

as.description: Attr key. Default: last path segment.

collectParams.description: Auto-hoist scalar leaves of *_param child messages into attrs. Default true.

display.description: First-match node subtitle templates. {path} = first value, {path*} = all values joined with ×. A rule with an unresolvable placeholder is skipped.

typeIn.description: Mapped type names this rule applies to. Omit for all.

netInputs.description: Synthesize source ops from top-level input/input_shape/input_dim declarations. Default true.

group.description: Derive layout group boxes from node names. Groups need ≥2 members to render.

delimiter.description: Prefix before this delimiter groups nodes, e.g. "/" for "conv1/bn".

regex.description: Capture group 1 is the group prefix.

matcher.description: AND of all present fields; array values mean "any of". Empty matcher matches every op.

opNameRegex.description: Auto-anchored regex on the op name.

opNameContains.description: Substring of the op name (loose; prefer opName).

attrHas.description: Attr key(s), at least one of which must be present.

when.description: Conditions on a captured region body (MLIR opaque regions). Fragments match op-name tokens, not substrings.
